crossRefs.note: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.
You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
“If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
“Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor…
Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out…
But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have…
Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.
You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not…
He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come…
“Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be…
when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come…
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
“When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in…
And not a hair of your head will perish.

translations.web: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
translations.bsb: Do not fear sudden danger or the ruin that overtakes the wicked,
translations.kjv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
translations.asv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, Neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh:
